test_bedrock_agentcore_basic_completion: test a bedrock agentcore non-streaming completion call using litellm with an ARN model identifier

test_bedrock_agentcore_jwt_auth: test bedrock agentcore completion with a jwt bearer token passed via the api_key parameter
